scope: Biological and industrial application datasets with actual chemical input/transport/response; not limited to MC bitstream testbeds

datasets.name: Polarization of yeast cells under different pheromone induction regimens
datasets.measurement_type: Real controlled microfluidic alpha-factor stimulation and single-cell polarity imaging
datasets.response: Continuous polarity metric; consult Data_Information.docx before parsing
datasets.priority: Biological extension, conditional on numerical attachment retrieval
limitations: Terminal NaN indicates G1 exclusion; internal NaN indicates out-of-focus frame
Cell counts, acquisition interval and independent date/run coverage remain unverified
No coded message stream or arbitrary adaptive-action outcomes
Transport calibration is separate from receiver response

datasets.name: Temporal perturbation of Erk dynamics reveals network architecture of FGF2-MAPK signaling
datasets.measurement_type: Real controlled growth-factor inputs and PC-12 single-cell FRET reporter responses
datasets.priority: Current executed biological pilot and pre-registered expanded fresh test
limitations: Only a paper-linked author GitHub numerical subset was acquired, not the complete Mendeley archive
Author-preprocessed normalized FRET is not a molecule count or a cell-fate endpoint
Experimental-day independence is not identifiable from these exports
Local delivered concentration and flow are not measured by this pilot
B3 is an original-author reference selected partly using these validation conditions, not a fresh blind comparator
No arbitrary new-action outcomes or novel closed-loop policy benefit
datasets.license_scope_note: CC BY 4.0 is the Mendeley record license. Author-repository code has no separately found root license; no new license is assigned.

protocols: single 60 min (timing inferred from author B3 simulations)
expanded_subset.note: Mixed 0.25 and 25 ng/ml were recorded as further channels of the inspected mixed experiment.

datasets.name: Rasterized Experimental Data: Vapor Advection Plumes for Open Research
datasets.measurement_type: Real wind-tunnel gas plume, MOS/PID recordings, spatial scans and fly-through trajectories
limitations: Synthetic plume means experimentally generated, not simulated
Sequential scanned maps are not instantaneous dynamic field truth
No arbitrary unexecuted robot-path outcomes
PID is a reference instrument, not noise-free concentration truth

datasets.name: Odour sensing in turbulent plumes with high-speed electronic nose and non-invasive ground truth
datasets.measurement_type: Real synchronized acetone PLIF concentration fields and MEMS MOx responses
datasets.priority: Promising industrial benchmark, conditional on archive retrieval
limitations: Data/code endpoints could not be independently expanded in this session
Interpolated 1 kHz concentration labels are not 1 kHz native ground truth
Actual observed design is five flow/location combinations, not a full 3x3 factorial
Fixed-temperature recordings do not validate active heater-control actions
No intentionally encoded source bitstream

datasets.name: Modular Open-Source Stirred Tank Reactor (MOSTR) experiment/calibration files
datasets.measurement_type: Real conductivity tracer, pump flow, stirrer speed and temperature
limitations: Head-height HH varied and was not recorded in teaching experiment
Limited teaching-session coverage; not an established large intervention dataset
